test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends N, M, O, P and Q are sitting in a column facing east (but not necessarily in the same order). O is sitting to the leftmost side. N is the immediate neighbour of M and Q. P is not sitting on any of the end seats. Who is the immediate neighbour of O?
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given information:

Step 1: O is sitting to the leftmost side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f2acbb975fae30a2e8cc9750011e0136653267692d09d1fa32ed1fe3faa0b17.png] 

Step 2: N is the immediate neighbour of M and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/253bfa342998a9c157507104eb780460207c284dd94e0a18de4d0aa382e58310.png] 

We have 4 spots and M,N,Q are seated together so we have to place them such that P can be seated with given conditions.

Step 3: P is not sitting on any of the end seats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64f007b8c70030f300f2df00d462ce60e0e65e26d6c44358b79ab3df514bd660.png] 

From the arrangement we can see that **P is the neighbor of O.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
